title: Native menus
summary: A macOS, Linux or Windows app that Tachyon builds has a menu bar. `tac.application.menus` in `client/manifest.json` adds your own items to the File, View and Help menus, and `tac.application.tray` adds an icon with its own menu to the system tray. An item opens a page of the app, or it runs a menu action: a method of a service that lives as long as the app.
